title: Manufacturing Performance & OEE Analyzer
summary: An independent, interactive manufacturing engineering model that calculates equipment effectiveness and partitions planned production time into availability, performance and quality losses using synthetic inputs.
outputs: Explicitly undefined factors for zero-output states
assumptions: Planned time excludes pre-scheduled production exclusions
Operating time is a subset of planned production time
Ideal cycle time is a positive theoretical cycle time per unit
Counts are nonnegative whole units, and good units never exceed total units
Examples are synthetic and not related to employer operations
limitations: Aggregate calculations cannot diagnose causes or distinguish stoppage events
No raw event ingestion, statistical confidence interval, downtime Pareto or bottleneck simulation
Different collection windows and cycle-time assumptions may produce incomparable OEE values
Undefined Performance or Quality factors are displayed as undefined, not assigned a measured value
Illustrative results are not verified production measurements
method: Availability = operating minutes / planned minutes; Performance = ideal cycle minutes for all units / operating minutes; Quality = good units / total units. OEE = ideal cycle minutes for good units / planned minutes. Time losses partition planned minutes as downtime, performance time, quality-equivalent time and effective output. Calculation rejects physically inconsistent inputs and reports undefined factors where denominators are zero.
